question.text:
Consider the following statements in respect of the function $f(x)=x^{3}-1, x \in[-1,1]$

I. $f(x)$ is increasing in [-1,1] 

II. $f(x)$ has no root in (-1,1) . 

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.text: Since $f(x)$ is an increasing function in [-1,1] and it has a root in (-1,1) $\therefore \quad$ Only statement $I$ is correct.
